content: rmcp 3.1.0 (July 2026) implements MCP spec 2026-07-28, backward-compatible with 2025-11-25. Features: server, macros, transport-streamable-http-server. Uses axum 0.8 + hyper 1 + tokio 1. StreamableHttpService::new() wraps handler, mount at /mcp path. Tool defined with #[tool(description=...)] macro on async fn, parameters via Parameters<T> extractor, returns CallToolResult. Simple tool execution returns JSON response (with_json_response(true)) instead of SSE stream. Cargo deps: rmcp = {version='0.8', features=['server','macros','transport-streamable-http-server']}, axum='0.8', serde+serde_json+schemars for parameter types.
